facts.fact: ASAL states that its first national conference on geospatial technologies for agriculture, held 29-30 November 2023 in Oran, heard presentations on ASAL's agriculture studies, Alsat-1B imagery to identify desert soils for farming, and the CropWatch crop-monitoring experience in Algeria.

DZA.note: The Office National de la Météorologie attended; no satellite use in forecasts is stated.
Two startups attended a conference; no startup law, label or fund is stated.
Nothing on hubs, incubators or technology parks.
